summary: Devin's $0 Free plan is offered through the Download/local desktop path and includes a light quota to code with agents, limited model availability, unlimited inline edits and unlimited Tab completions. The pricing page lists access to cloud agents (Devin Cloud) under paid Pro, not Free; this offer does not promise free dashboard/cloud-agent sessions.
claim_steps: Open https://devin.ai/pricing and use Download under the Free $0 plan.
Install the downloaded local desktop app and follow its account setup/sign-in flow.
Use local agent coding within the light Free quota and limited model availability; inline edits and Tab completions are unlimited.
Do not expect Free to include Devin Cloud sessions: access to cloud agents is listed under paid Pro.

social_proof.title: Devin pricing — Free $0 plan
social_proof.text: Free $0 Download. Light quota to code with agents. Limited model availability. Unlimited inline edits. Unlimited Tab completions. Pro: Everything in Free, plus: Access to cloud agents (Devin Cloud).
